sop_modules.name: Sand Prep of Primed Surface
sop_modules.notes: Sand the already-primed surface with 220 grit to create tooth for grain filler adhesion. Surface must already be primed by parent spec. No protection setup needed — parent spec's workspace protection is in place.

tasks.name: Sand primed surface 220 grit before grain fill
tasks.notes: 220 grit sanding on primed surface. Orbital sander on flat surfaces, hand sand on profiles. Creates tooth for grain filler adhesion. Surface must be clean and dust-free after sanding — tack cloth before fill application.

sop_modules.name: Grain Filler Application
sop_modules.run_rule: Runs per fill coat — QT3: 1 coat, QT4: 2 coats, QT5: 3 coats
sop_modules.notes: Apply water-based grain filler (AquaCoat or equivalent) as a skim coat. Squeegee on flat surfaces to force filler into grain pores, brush on profiled surfaces. Wipe excess off cross-grain. Each coat fills grain pores progressively deeper.

tasks.name: Apply grain filler skim coat
tasks.notes: Squeegee filler across flat surfaces forcing material into grain pores. Brush into profiled areas. Wipe excess off cross-grain for flat skim coat. QT3: 1 coat. QT4: 2 coats. QT5: 3 coats. Each successive coat fills remaining grain texture.

sop_modules.name: Sand Between Fill Coats
sop_modules.run_rule: Runs AFTER each fill coat — matches fill coat count
sop_modules.notes: Sand between fill coats to level the surface and prepare for next coat or next phase. Grit progresses: first sand 220 grit, subsequent sands 280-320 grit. Orbital on flats, hand on profiles.

tasks.name: Sand between fill coats
tasks.notes: Sand filled surface level. First sand: 220 grit. Second sand (QT4+): 280-320 grit. Third sand (QT5): 320 grit. Orbital sander on flats, hand sand on profiles. Tack cloth after each sand.

sop_modules.name: Final Sand (QT5 Only)
sop_modules.notes: QT5-only final sand at 400 grit before second prime coat. Produces glass-smooth surface. Hand work only — 400 grit requires fine control.

tasks.name: Final sand 400 grit (QT5 only)
tasks.notes: 400 grit hand sand for glass-smooth surface before second prime coat. QT5 only. Hand work — no orbital at this grit. Check with angled light for uniformity.

sop_modules.name: Second Prime Coat (Seal Coat)
sop_modules.notes: Apply second prime coat over grain-filled surface to seal and encapsulate the filler. Uses same primer as parent spec. Sand 320 grit after prime for finish coat adhesion. This outputs SS_GRAIN_FILLED state.

tasks.name: Apply second prime coat (seal coat over filler)
tasks.notes: Full primer coat over grain-filled surface. Uses parent spec's primer system — same product as initial prime coat. Encapsulates filler and provides uniform base for finish coat. Standard primer application rate.

tasks.name: Sand second prime 320 grit
tasks.notes: 320 grit sand of second prime coat. Light sand for finish coat adhesion tooth. Orbital on flats, hand on profiles. Tack cloth after sanding. Surface is now SS_GRAIN_FILLED and ready for finish paint.

workflow_sequence.qt4_standard: MOD_GRAIN_PREP > MOD_GRAIN_FILL(1) > MOD_GRAIN_INTERSTAGE(1) > MOD_GRAIN_FILL(2) > MOD_GRAIN_INTERSTAGE(2) > MOD_GRAIN_SEAL
workflow_sequence.qt5_standard: MOD_GRAIN_PREP > MOD_GRAIN_FILL(1) > MOD_GRAIN_INTERSTAGE(1) > MOD_GRAIN_FILL(2) > MOD_GRAIN_INTERSTAGE(2) > MOD_GRAIN_FILL(3) > MOD_GRAIN_INTERSTAGE(3) > MOD_GRAIN_FINAL > MOD_GRAIN_SEAL
workflow_sequence.notes: Fill and interstage modules repeat per QT coat count. MOD_GRAIN_FINAL is QT5-only. MOD_GRAIN_SEAL always runs last (all tiers). No setup/cleanup — parent spec handles workspace.

round_configurations.name: QT3 grain fill (1 fill coat)
round_configurations.notes: Sand prep + 1 fill coat + 1 sand between + second prime + sand prime. 5 task executions total.

round_configurations.name: QT4 grain fill (2 fill coats)
round_configurations.notes: Sand prep + 2 fill coats + 2 sands between + second prime + sand prime. 7 task executions total.

round_configurations.name: QT5 grain fill (3 fill coats + final sand)
round_configurations.description: Three fill coats + final sand + seal coat
round_configurations.notes: Sand prep + 3 fill coats + 3 sands between + final sand (400 grit) + second prime + sand prime. 10 task executions total.
